shared_elements: carved figural forms in stone with schematic, simplified anatomy
possible animal or creature form perched on/above another element
justification: A depicts a multi-register relief scene with a row of quadrupeds, a hatched band, a bird-like creature, a small human figure and a scorpion, while B is a single sculpted head dominated by heavy brow, deep eye hollows and a broad muzzle/chin, with only a vague crouching mass above. The only real correspondence is the shared taste for boldly schematic, blocky rendering of creatures and eye-sockets; there is no shared scene, no shared arrangement of registers, and no repeated specific motif.
